node.statement: Reapplying the extended-isomorphism estimate from lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization, lem-thmainext-conditional, and def-extended-delta-inclusion gives ||v_nX||>=(1-C_V*eta)||X|| for every n. Because (1.1) gives C_V*eta<=1/4, v_n is bijective and ||v_n^(-1)||<=1/(1-C_V*eta). Thus tilde-Upsilon_n=v_n^(-1) tilde-Phi_n has norm at most (1+C_theta*eta)/(1-C_V*eta), uniformly in n; taking the supremum gives the stated cb bound.
